trust_decision.summary: MOL2 reader trusts the atom id from a @<TRIPOS>UNITY_ATOM_ATTR record: it checks only the upper bound (aid <= NumAtoms) and then dereferences OBMol::GetAtom(aid), which returns nullptr for aid < 1.

landing_point.why: The summary names MOL2 and SetFormalCharge, and this is the only SetFormalCharge call on a file-supplied index in the MOL2 reader.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The commit's other two hunks (src/formats/xml/cdxmlformat.cpp, fix.diff:27-37; src/math/transform3d.cpp, fix.diff:45-53) fix separate bugs bundled into the same commit ('Fix 3 CVE security bugs', fix.diff:2). They are not part of this advisory's MOL2 scope.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about MOL2 only, so a solver could argue that other format readers (Culgi COF, ChemDoodle JSON) are separate plugins with their own bugs and not this advisory's problem.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid UNITY_ATOM_ATTR charge records written by the MOL2 writer for round-tripping formal charges must still be applied. An over-broad fix (rejecting the section or failing the read) would break this, and test/testbabel.py:509-511 exercises it.

O6_input_shapes: aid == 0 (also the default when sscanf fails on the header line, src/formats/mol2format.cpp:409-412)
negative aid (int compared against unsigned NumAtoms; GetAtom rejects it via an unsigned cast, src/mol.cpp:832)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Culgi COF reader: the 'formalq' line's atom index goes to GetAtom(iAtom+1)->SetFormalCharge without a bounds or null check (same setter, same mechanism).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different, obscure format plugin that the MOL2 advisory never mentions.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ChemDoodle JSON reader: the bond check tests only the upper bound ((unsigned)begin > NumAtoms), so begin/end == 0 (a missing 'b'/'e' or the value -1) gives GetAtom(0)=nullptr->AddBond. This is the same missing lower bound as the MOL2 bug.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: JSON subpackage, different sink method (AddBond, not SetFormalCharge), bond rather than charge record.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Jaguar reader: the ESP charge loop increments chgcount per token without bounding it to NumAtoms, then calls GetAtom(chgcount)->SetPartialCharge.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Partial charge rather than formal charge, computational-chemistry output format, and the loop condition looks bounded.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A residue/substructure record that looks atoms up by a file-supplied id instead of NumAtoms().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MOL2 has a @<TRIPOS>SUBSTRUCTURE section with root_atom ids that a maintainer could plausibly parse with the same upper-bound-only check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An additional 'M  xxx' property handled outside the checked branch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The MDL property-block dispatcher already handles 7 property kinds, and adding one with a direct GetAtom deref is a natural maintenance slip. The existing check here is the project's own correct model.

O9_family: NULL pointer dereference from an unchecked file-supplied atom index (missing lower bound) in format parsers

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + C++ compiler (gcc/clang); Eigen/zlib/libxml2/RapidJSON optional per format
O10_build.project_tests: test/testbabel.py (MOL2 UNITY_ATOM_ATTR round-trip at test/testbabel.py:494-524); culgi_*.mol2 files in test/files

j.j_sites_touched: src/formats/mol2format.cpp (advisory scope); the commit also touches src/formats/xml/cdxmlformat.cpp and src/math/transform3d.cpp for separate bugs
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a null check after GetAtom(aid) in mol2format.cpp only (or add the aid >= 1 bound) and stop, leaving the COF and ChemDoodle JSON readers open.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit bundles two unrelated bugs (CDXML implicit-H null atom, fix.diff:27-37; transform3d symmetry-string infinite scan, fix.diff:45-53). They likely belong to sibling advisories.
src/formats/xml/cmlformat.cpp:1046-1131 dereferences GetAtom(AtomRefIdx[..]) for stereo refs. It was not inspected for bounds.
